name: Tepotinib
drugClass: Selective MET tyrosine kinase inhibitor (type Ib)
mechanism: Highly selective, reversible type Ib MET kinase inhibitor used for MET exon 14 skipping NSCLC.
interactions: Inhibits P-glycoprotein; caution with narrow-therapeutic-index P-gp substrates (e.g. dabigatran, digoxin). Take with food.
resistance: MET kinase-domain mutations, MET amplification and bypass activation.
